text:
Maya (Support): Patrick from AcmeCorp pinged us — they say their org hit the monthly token cap 6 hours earlier than expected. Customer is on monthly billing, timezone PST.
Patrick (Acme Corp): hey, we usually see reset at midnight local, but today our usage dropped to 0 at ~18:30 UTC which is ~11:30am PST. need this to not break our app.
Maya (Support): thanks — can you paste your org id and the account page screenshot? also did you change plan or invite new seats recently?
Patrick (Acme Corp): org: org_01GZ..., no plan change, no new seats. screenshot attached (not in thread).
Maya (Support): @Sam can you check quota/reset job logs for org_01GZ... around 2024-04-xx 18:00-19:00 UTC?
Sam (SRE): on it. initial thought: reset runs at 00:00 UTC for all monthly cycles. odd that it would run mid-day. pulling job history now.
Billing Bot: scheduled_quota_reset job started for billing-cycle 2024-04-01 at 00:00:03 UTC (success)
Sam (SRE): reset job looks fine yesterday at 00:00 UTC. however I see an on-demand refill record at 2024-04-15T18:28:45Z that reduced available tokens to 0 for org_01GZ... — looks like an automatic pro-rata adjustment from a plan change API call.
Maya (Support): but customer says they didn't change plan. maybe another API actor triggered it?
Jordan (Engineering): can you fetch the audit trail for that org for admin actions? `SELECT * FROM audit.events WHERE org='org_01GZ...' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 20;`
Sam (SRE): paste of audit lines:
```
2024-04-15T18:28:41Z  svc-internal  action:billing.adjust_quota  actor:svc-billing-sync  details:{old:1200000,new:0,reason:"sync-mismatch"}
2024-04-15T18:28:40Z  cron/usage-sync  action:usage.sync  actor:cron  details:{consumed:1200000}
```
Jordan (Engineering): hmm svc-billing-sync did an adjust_quota to 0 — that looks like a bug in the sync where a null/empty field maps to zero instead of preserving quota. I can reproduce locally with a missing 'balance' field.
Maya (Support): Jordan, ETA on a mitigation? Can we rollback the quota for this org immediately? Customer is live.
Jordan (Engineering): I can run a one-off fix to set remaining tokens back to expected based on last invoice. Will coordinate with Sam to apply.
Sam (SRE): patch applied: `billing.adjust_quota(org='org_01GZ...', delta=+1200000) -- id 0x7b2`
Maya (Support): Patrick — we've restored your tokens. Please verify if your apps can resume. Sorry for the disruption.
Patrick (Acme Corp): confirmed — services back, thanks. Any idea what triggered the svc-billing-sync?
Jordan (Engineering): root cause: a downstream partner API returned an empty payload during usage-sync, our mapper treated missing balance as zero and created an adjust_quota action. Fix: add validation to ignore null balances and add sanity checks to the sync so it never writes zero without a matching invoice.
Maya (Support): notes for KB: when customers report a reset outside scheduled UTC refill check: 1) verify scheduled_reset job at 00:00 UTC 2) check audit.events for billing.adjust_quota and usage.sync around reported time 3) look for svc-billing-sync actor or partner sync failures 4) if adjust_quota to 0 found, escalate to eng and apply one-off restore if safe.
Jordan (Engineering): I'll open a tracking ticket with high priority and patch to validate partner payloads. also adding metric alerts when adjust_quota drops >50% in <5m.
Sam (SRE): added incident tag and doc link to runbook.
Maya (Support): follow-up with customer: explaining cause and that there will be a patch to prevent recurrence. cc @billing for post-mortem entry. :thumbsup:
Patrick (Acme Corp): thanks team, appreciate the quick turnaround.
Maya (Support): closing thread once post-mortem and KB entry are up.
